metadata.title: Execute Implementation
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Execute code changes following the approved implementation plan. Create/modify files, implement business logic, wire dependencies, and update config/infra.

output.description: Code changes across affected files following the plan

specificActions: Follow the plan step-by-step in order: dependencies/config → module wiring → feature code → infra/DevOps → tests
Create/modify files as specified in the plan
Follow existing codebase patterns and conventions
Use business-domain names, not technical/infrastructure names
bestPractices: Follow the plan order — don't skip ahead
Match existing code style and patterns
Document any deviations from the plan with justification
Keep changes focused — don't refactor unrelated code

substeps.name: Implement dependencies and config
actions: Set up environment variables if needed

substeps.name: Implement feature code
actions: Implement business logic following the plan

substeps.name: Store implementation progress
actions: List all files created and modified
Note deviations from plan with justification

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
actions: Output: '✓ Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Dependencies/config → module wiring → feature code → infra/DevOps → store progress
